method: Each path frame was read on the source video (sequential decode, seek-checked: offset 0 MAD 0.0, +-1 MAD 14-23): ball (x,y,r) eye-read on a gridded crop (purple blob only where its circle was checked on the lane crop), and in the SAME frame at the ball centre row the left/right lane edges at the wood/gutter boundary (Sobel-x peak, every marker inspected on a gridded lane-width crop, near-frame right edges read on 5x crops with grey profiles); board = 1 + 38*(x - right_x)/(left_x - right_x), no quad carry-over. Entry = median of 6 named reads: edge profile at pin_hit-1/0/+1, pin ruler at f376/f377 using PHYSICAL pin geometry (7 visible columns = 7,4,2,1/5,3,6,10 at 6 in spacing, 7-to-10 = 36 in = 32.97 units of 41.5/38 in, headpin = board 20; the task text's 7->33 / 10->7 / 11-17-23-29 mapping is self-contradictory and was not used), and a ball-diameter ruler at f376 (2r = 7.78 units, distance from the right edge); extra keys contact_y/left_x_contact/right_x_contact/board_contact re-read the edges at the ball's contact row y+r (deviation from the spec, board stays the row-y read).
limits: Ball centres +-1.5 px at the far end (r 8.5-12), +-3 px near (r 23-63, motion-smeared at 332/338). Edges +-2 px at the far end (=+-0.8 board), +-4 px near; near-end right edges are blurred grey ramps (332, 338, 344) and the 2x crops misled the first eye reads by 14-22 px, so those three come from 5x crops plus grey profiles. Scale disagreement at f376 (unresolved, worth ~1.5 boards at board 12 if the edge scale were wrong): lane edges 95 px / 38 units = 2.50 px/unit, pin columns 60 px / 32.97 units = 1.82 px/unit, ball 18 px / 7.78 units = 2.31 px/unit; pin span / lane width = 0.63 against physical 36/41.5 = 0.87. With the task text's 7->33/10->7 mapping (26 units) the pin ruler would read 12.86 (f376) and 13.18 (f377). Ball radius is +-1 px at r 9 (+-11 % of the ball-ruler scale). The rack sits 4-5 px right of the edge midpoint (headpin column 389 vs (337+432)/2 = 384.5 at f376). Path 332-344 are on the camera's downswing/upswing (heavy blur), so the near-end board is +-1.5.

pin_row.note: Re-derived. Head top detected on f382/389-392 at 841.4/840.2/840.3/840.4/840.4 camera-compensated (crosses checked on prow_377_395.jpg). Ball bottom reaches the base at f393 (f392 +2.8), centre at f390. contact_frame - k = 395, 2 frames later. The f393 ball is a partial blob behind pins (3 px from prediction). Pin ruler: f392 columns (headpin 414, 10.0 px per 6 in) moved by camera dx -1.9 to f393.
pin_row.note_prev: NOT re-derived; kept 377 from the existing truth, flagged as early. pin_row_y 895 equals the ball row at the cut pin_hit, yet on zoom_376_391_410_885.jpg the ball is in front of the standing rack through f386, first overlapped by front pins at f387-388, and the first pin moves at f396, 19 frames after 377. As on 191913/191253 the base row is most likely the bottom of the deck reflection; the frame where the ball's contact point reaches the head row is probably f386-388 (first occlusion by a front pin), not measured; WITHDRAWN: 2D overlap, not occlusion; use est_60ft_frame_from_contact instead. No pin-ruler read: the pin columns at f377 sit behind the ball's upper half.
pin_row.method: pin-height base: headpin-column pin top (head top, not the neck stripe) + 15 in x lane px/in at the base row + 3.5 px (topmost white is the 5-pin, 20.8 in behind), per frame where detected within 6 px of the camera-compensated top, else compensated top + measured camera dy; ball centre from the path or a tracked purple component, r = geometric radius scaled by lane width; frame_contact_row = first frame with (y + r) - base <= +1 px.
pin_row.est_60ft_note: contact_frame - k, k=1 = rack row of the first pin within 6.1 units of the ball's board (about 1 frame per row); first visible pin motion lags the touch, so this is an upper bound

contact_note: Ball behind the front pins f388-395 with all pins upright; pins around x 400-420 blur and lean at f396, clearly falling f397-399 (zoom_392_407_402_872.jpg). Aligned change 11.8 (f395) -> 27.7 (f396). +-1. This is 19 frames after the cut pin_hit 377.

exit.deflection: came in right of the headpin (board ~11.6), went through the rack moving left about 10 boards and dropped off the back of the deck behind the headpin/2-pin line

exit_method: Ball read by eye on 5x camera-followed gridded crops (zoom_376_391_410_885.jpg, zoom_392_407_402_872.jpg) and matched to the moving purple component; lane edges are the wood-to-gutter Sobel step on rows 862-903 in front of the deck in the exit frame itself (rms 0.29-0.33 px), evaluated at the ball row. Pin ruler: 7 columns 387..447 at f390 (10.0 px per 6 in, headpin 419) moved to f403 by the measured camera dx.
exit_limits: Edge lines are extrapolated 60-100 px to the ball row. f403 is the last full disc; f404-406 show only a 3-5 px purple sliver at the top of the ball as it drops into the pit (component height 3-4 px), so if the scorer counts any visible part the exit is f406. The pin ruler reads 1.7 boards above the edges.
